business_problem: Rebendo’s customers lacked real-time visibility into network and application bottlenecks, making it hard to explain slow transactions, preserve availability and automate operations at scale.
solution_summary: Rebendo combined its own Rebendo Insight platform with IBM Instana to give customers continuous observability across applications, infrastructure and network behavior. The company had seen a recurring pattern among clients: they could detect that response times were degrading, but they could not explain the root cause quickly enough to prevent service issues. By instrumenting environments with Instana and feeding that telemetry into Rebendo Insight dashboards, the joint solution provides second-level visibility into system behavior instead of minute-level snapshots. That richer signal supports faster diagnosis, highlights bottlenecks across distributed services and creates a foundation for broader AIOps automation. In practice, customers can move from vague slowdown complaints to measurable, traceable performance data that operations teams can use to restore service and improve reliability.

solution_components.name: Rebendo Insight
solution_components.role: Presents detailed dashboards that give users operational visibility into applications and network behavior.

solution_components.name: IBM Instana
solution_components.role: Collects observability telemetry and traces system behavior in real time to pinpoint bottlenecks and latency issues.

data_flow: Telemetry from customer environments is captured by IBM Instana and surfaced through Rebendo Insight dashboards, where operations teams review second-level performance data, isolate bottlenecks and trigger corrective action.
business_outcome: The combined platform improved operational visibility for customers, reduced the effort needed for onsite oversight and enabled faster diagnosis of performance issues in transaction-heavy environments.
architecture_clues: Supports high-volume transaction environments such as clearing houses
Positioned as a foundation for AIOps automation journeys
evidence_quotes: For example, they would have a response time go up by 10 to 20 seconds, but they had no idea where the bottleneck was that was causing the delay.
